title: UNDER 90 CHARS
takeaway: 90% of Instagram users have been inspired to visit a local business after seeing it on the platform.

data.evidence: Also, consider creating your own branded hashtag to encourage customers to share their experiences. A recent survey found that businesses using branded hashtags saw a 30% increase in engagement.

narration: Instagram is a powerful tool for local businesses, allowing them to visually showcase their products and services.  Consistent engagement and strategic content are key to success.  Paid advertising can boost reach and drive traffic, while tracking performance with Instagram Insights is crucial for optimizing your strategy.
